title: The Blue Ribbon Ledger
timeRule: Time advances only through simulated days via Start Another Day. Evidence carries in-game day stamps such as Day 1, never weekdays, calendar dates or clock times. Delayed events fire after a number of simulated days, never at a set hour.
narrativeGuardrail: Wholly fictional charity, people and crimes. The investigation stays abstract and non-instructional, and the home invasion implies rather than depicts violence.

cast.name: Elena Cross
cast.role: Blue Ribbon organizer, missing since gala night (Day 1)

cast.name: R.M.
cast.role: Catering supervisor who saw the end of the night

volunteer.label: Gala volunteer
volunteer.detail: Found by people who cleared the tables after the benefit.

records.label: Foundation account books
records.detail: A page torn from the Scholarship Drive disbursement ledger.

slip_caller.label: R.M., a caller to the newsroom
slip_caller.detail: A message copied down by the Sunfall Daily front desk.

statement_witness.label: Unnamed catering supervisor
statement_witness.detail: A police statement with the witness's name blacked out.

witness_rm.label: R.M., catering supervisor
witness_rm.detail: One witness. The phone slip and the police statement both come from this person.

press.label: Sunfall Daily photo desk
press.detail: A published photograph and caption from the Day 2 edition.

rumour.label: Group-chat rumor
rumour.detail: Forwarded third-hand. Nobody in the chain saw it themselves.

planted.label: Unsigned note
planted.detail: Slipped under your door after you began asking questions.

scraps.title: Torn gala ticket
scraps.reliabilityNote: A genuine ticket, but anyone could have pencilled the note on the back.
scraps.handwriting: No name on list. Per A.P.
scraps.hint: Someone who cleared the tables, or a lost-property box, may have it.

scraps.title: Charity ledger fragment
scraps.reliabilityNote: An original accounts page, though torn and incomplete.
scraps.heading: SCHOLARSHIP DRIVE: DISBURSEMENTS
scraps.hint: The Foundation keeps the books. Insiders, or a careless office, might share a page.

scraps.title: Telephone message slip
scraps.reliabilityNote: Second-hand: a receptionist copied the caller's words.
scraps.handwriting: Gray sedan at the old junction after the benefit. D.K. driving. Someone from Table 9 beside him. Please call me back.
scraps.hint: Elena had been talking to the newspaper. Ask who left messages for her.

scraps.title: Cropped newspaper photograph
scraps.reliabilityNote: A published photograph, but the caption leaves someone out.
scraps.caption: Treasurer Augustus Pell with organizer Elena Cross as the benefit closed (Day 1). Door security: Officer A. Porter.
scraps.column: …Mr. Pell said he left early and did not see Ms. Cross again that night. All Scholarship Drive payments were frozen on Day 2, he added…
scraps.hint: Read the Day 2 Sunfall Daily in full and clip the gala photograph.

scraps.title: Redacted witness statement
scraps.reliabilityNote: A formal statement, but the names are blacked out.
scraps.heading: SUNFALL POLICE · WITNESS STATEMENT · TAKEN DAY 2

statement.text: After the benefit (Day 1) I saw Ms. Cross arguing with the treasurer by the service door. Mr. K
told me my late-service invoice would be paid from the Scholarship Drive and that I should go home. Later I passed a gray sedan parked at the old junction. Signed: R. M

scraps.hint: Police contacts, or a newspaper that already holds a copy.

scraps.title: Group-chat rumor
scraps.reliabilityNote: Forwarded third-hand. Nobody in the chain saw it.
scraps.handwriting: Everyone's saying Elena ran off with a married donor after the gala!! Someone saw her get into a really nice car.

scraps.title: Unsigned note
scraps.reliabilityNote: No sender. It arrived after people noticed your questions.
scraps.handwriting: ASK OFFICER PORTER WHERE SHE DROVE E.C. AFTER THE BENEFIT.

claims.text: A.P. approved the unlisted seat and also signed the Halcyon Ridge payments.
The unlisted Table 9 seat was paid for as Table 9 hospitality.
Someone from Table 9 was in the gray sedan with D.K.
The A.P. who seated the unlisted guest is Officer A. Porter from the door.
claims.hint: Officer Porter worked the door and logged arrivals. Check who actually signs things off before you pin A.P. on her.

claims.text: The A.P. who seated the unlisted guest is Treasurer Augustus Pell.
The treasurer the witness saw arguing is the A.P. who placed the unlisted guest.
D.K., who signed the late payments, was the one driving the gray sedan.
A.P. in the ledger is Treasurer Augustus Pell.
A.P. in the ledger is Officer A. Porter.
claims.hint: A police officer on door duty signing charity payments? Look at who the newspaper says runs the money.

claims.text: Pell says payments were frozen on Day 2, yet A.P. signed a Day 2 payment to Halcyon Ridge.
D.K. in the ledger is the man in the D. KE… lanyard, cropped out of the caption.
The witness's late-service invoice is D.K.'s Late service entry.
The Mr. K… in the statement is the D.K. who signs the ledger.
The driver D.K. is the man in the D. KE… lanyard left out of the caption.
Elena Cross is named on both.
R.M. on the slip and the redacted R. M… are the same catering supervisor.
Two separate witnesses saw the gray sedan at the old junction.
claims.hint: Read the slip and the statement side by side. Are you sure they come from two different people?

claims.text: Pell says he left early, but the witness saw Ms. Cross arguing with the treasurer after the benefit.
Elena left the benefit willingly with a married donor.
claims.hint: A rumor forwarded three times is not a sighting. Nobody can name the donor.

claims.text: The gray sedan was the donor's car taking Elena away.
claims.hint: The slip names the driver. The rumor names nobody.

claims.text: Officer Porter seated the unlisted guest and drove E.C. away.
claims.hint: Who benefits if you chase a police officer? That note arrived right after you started asking questions.

claims.text: Officer Porter, on the door, is the A.P. who drove E.C. from the benefit.
claims.hint: Who benefits if you chase a police officer? That note arrived right after you started asking questions.

weakDayClaim: Both date from gala night (Day 1). Half the city was there, so this proves little by itself.

thunderbirds.label: Ask what she saw at Table 9
thunderbirds.player: You mentioned the gala. Did anything odd happen around Table 9?
thunderbirds.reply: Table 9 was the treasurer's table. I found this torn ticket when we cleared it. There was no name for that seat on the plan. Please don't tell the committee I sent it.
thunderbirds.suspicionReason: A Bluebirds volunteer mentioned your Table 9 questions to the committee.

thunderbirds.label: Ask who keeps the Scholarship Drive books
thunderbirds.player: Who keeps the Scholarship Drive accounts?
thunderbirds.reply: The treasurer and the events director sign everything. I tidied the office and found a torn page in the shredding bag. Here. Delete this chat.
thunderbirds.suspicionReason: A torn ledger page went missing from the Foundation office.

thunderbirds.label: Ask whether she knows an R.M. from catering
thunderbirds.player: Do you know someone called R.M. who worked catering at the gala?
thunderbirds.reply: R.M.? That must be Ruth from late service. Why? The committee has been asking about her too…
thunderbirds.suspicionReason: You asked a Bluebirds volunteer to identify your witness.

police.label: Ask whether a witness came forward
police.player: Has anyone come forward about the night of the gala?
police.reply: I can't share statements. But the paper already has a redacted copy, so here it is. The names are blacked out for a reason. Keep it that way.

police.label: Ask about Officer Porter on the door
police.player: What was Officer Porter doing at the gala?
police.reply: Abigail Porter ran the door and logged every arrival. She flagged an unlisted guest at Table 9 to her sergeant that same night. Whoever told you she's involved is wrong.
police.clue: Police: Officer Porter logged arrivals and reported the unlisted Table 9 guest herself.

fourth_estate.label: Ask about messages left for Elena
fourth_estate.player: Did anyone leave messages for Elena at the paper?
fourth_estate.reply: Elena had been talking to our city desk. The front desk took this message for her on gala night. We never reached the caller. If you find them, protect them.

fourth_estate.label: Ask her to look over your evidence sheet
fourth_estate.player: Could you look over the connections I've pinned?

progressives.label: Ask what people are saying about Elena
progressives.player: What's the group chat saying about Elena Cross?
progressives.reply: The group chat says she ran off with a married donor. Someone saw her get into a nice car. I'd take it with a pinch of salt.

goth_girls.label: Ask what people are saying about Elena
goth_girls.player: What are people saying about Elena Cross?
goth_girls.reply: The after-party crowd says she eloped with some donor. It sounds like a story somebody wanted told.

sisters_of_mercy.label: Ask whether anything was handed in after the gala
sisters_of_mercy.player: Was anything handed in after the charity gala?
sisters_of_mercy.reply: One of our volunteers found a torn ticket and put it in the lost-property box. Sister Margaret thought it might matter to someone. Here is a photograph of it.

service:police.label: Ask about Officer Porter's door log
service:police.reply: Officer Porter logged every arrival at the benefit. She reported an unlisted guest at Table 9 that same night. Please don't spread her name about.
service:police.clue: Police: Officer Porter logged arrivals and reported the unlisted Table 9 guest herself.

service:newsroom.label: Ask about messages left for Elena
service:newsroom.reply: Elena had been talking to our city desk. Our front desk took a message for her on gala night. I'll send you a copy. Whoever R.M. is, they're frightened.

service:newsroom.label: Ask for the paper's redacted witness statement
service:newsroom.reply: We obtained a police statement with the names blacked out. You've been straight with us, so here is our copy. Don't try to unmask the witness.

service:newsroom.label: Ask the city desk to review your evidence
Tell the reporter who your witness is
service:newsroom.suspicionReason: You gave your witness's identity to a newsroom with leaky phone lines.
service:newsroom.reply: Thank you. I'll try to reach her… although our lines aren't exactly private these days.

service:newsroom.label: Go on the record: accuse Treasurer Pell
Go on the record: accuse Officer Porter

service:chapel.label: Ask about the lost-property box
service:chapel.reply: A volunteer handed in a torn gala ticket. Sister Margaret will send you a photograph of it. We hope it helps someone.

service:foundation.label: Ask about Elena Cross
service:foundation.suspicionReason: The Foundation office logged your call about Elena Cross.
service:foundation.reply: Ms. Cross is on personal leave. May I take your name? …Hello?

service:foundation.label: Ask who sat at Table 9
service:foundation.suspicionReason: You asked the Foundation about the treasurer's table.
service:foundation.reply: Table 9 is the treasurer's own table. Why would you want to know that?
service:foundation.clue: Foundation office: Table 9 was Treasurer Pell's own table.

service:foundation.label: Pose as a donor and ask for the accounts
service:foundation.suspicionReason: A donor asked the Foundation for its disbursement records.
service:foundation.reply: Of course, we value our donors. I'll photograph the disbursement sheet for you… oh dear, it's half torn. I'll send what I have.

service:foundation.label: Accuse the treasurer to his own office

service:federal.label: Ask what investigators need
service:federal.reply: Three independent sources that back each other up. No rumors, no theories that the records contradict. And any witness must stay protected: if their name has leaked, we can't use them.

foundation.name: Blue Ribbon Foundation
foundation.greeting: Blue Ribbon Foundation, Scholarship Drive office. How may I help?

federal.name: Federal field office
federal.greeting: Federal field office, public reporting line. Go ahead.

warning.title: RESIDENTS REPORT CAR CIRCLING QUIET STREETS
warning.summary: A gray sedan has been seen idling on residential streets.
warning.body: Neighbors say the same car has parked near several homes on your side of town. Police urge residents to report anything unusual and to keep doors locked.

witnessGone.title: CATERING WORKER IN CHARITY CASE LEAVES SUNFALL
witnessGone.summary: A late-service supervisor has left the city and withdrawn her statement.
witnessGone.body: Friends say she packed in a hurry after too many people started asking about her. Police confirm a witness statement in the Blue Ribbon case has been withdrawn.

success.title: FEDERAL OFFICIALS REVIEW BLUE RIBBON RECORDS
success.summary: Investigators have taken the Scholarship Drive's books after a resident submitted a dossier.
success.body: A federal spokesperson called the file unusually well corroborated. The source and the witness involved are being protected.

success.title: TREASURER AND EVENTS DIRECTOR QUESTIONED OVER CHARITY PAYMENTS
success.summary: Augustus Pell and Dorian Kell were interviewed about transfers to the Halcyon Ridge Trust.
success.body: The food bank and scholarships will continue under independent trustees. Most of our volunteers did nothing wrong, a new trustee said.

success.title: ELENA CROSS FOUND SAFE AFTER HIDING FROM THREATS
success.summary: The organizer contacted investigators once the inquiry became public.
success.body: Ms. Cross says she went into hiding on gala night after being threatened near the old junction. She thanked whoever kept asking the right questions.

success.title: BLUE RIBBON VOLUNTEERS RETURN TO THE FOOD BANK
success.summary: The charity's legitimate work carries on under new trustees.
success.body: Volunteers who had no part in the Halcyon Ridge payments say they are relieved. Scholarships already promised will be honored.

failed_report.title: FEDERAL OFFICE DECLINES BLUE RIBBON COMPLAINT
failed_report.summary: Officials call a resident's dossier speculative and partly contradicted by records.
failed_report.body: A spokesperson said the file relied on theories that could not be corroborated. No inquiry will be opened.

failed_report.title: FOUNDATION WELCOMES END TO RUMORS
failed_report.summary: Treasurer Augustus Pell says the charity will move on.
failed_report.body: Payments to the Halcyon Ridge Trust have quietly resumed. Elena Cross remains missing.

failed_report.title: BLUE RIBBON CASE GOES COLD
failed_report.summary: Police say there are no new lines of inquiry.
failed_report.body: Volunteers who once spoke to the newspaper now decline to comment.

failed_accusation.title: RESIDENT ACCUSES BLUE RIBBON TREASURER
failed_accusation.summary: A caller to this newspaper named Augustus Pell in the Elena Cross case.
failed_accusation.body: The claims were made before any official inquiry. The Foundation called them reckless and defamatory.

failed_accusation.title: PELL DENIES CLAIMS AS FOUNDATION THREATENS LEGAL ACTION
failed_accusation.summary: Lawyers for the treasurer demand a retraction.
failed_accusation.body: Several volunteers who had spoken privately about the gala have stopped answering calls.

failed_accusation.title: KEY WITNESS WITHDRAWS STATEMENT IN CHARITY CASE
failed_accusation.summary: Police confirm a statement in the Blue Ribbon case has been withdrawn.
failed_accusation.body: Investigators say the public accusation made a difficult case much harder.

failed_accusation.title: FEDERAL REVIEW OF BLUE RIBBON CLOSED WITHOUT CHARGES
failed_accusation.summary: Officials cite insufficient evidence after witnesses withdrew.
failed_accusation.body: Elena Cross remains missing. The Scholarship Drive continues under its existing board.

failed_wrong_accusation.title: RESIDENT ACCUSES OFFICER OVER MISSING ORGANIZER
failed_wrong_accusation.summary: A caller claimed Officer A. Porter drove Elena Cross from the benefit.
failed_wrong_accusation.body: The police department said the claim was 'false and contradicted by the officer's own records'.

failed_wrong_accusation.title: POLICE: OFFICER FLAGGED UNLISTED GALA GUEST; CLAIM DISMISSED
failed_wrong_accusation.summary: Officer Porter reported the unlisted Table 9 guest on gala night.
failed_wrong_accusation.body: Detectives say the false accusation cost the inquiry several days. The Foundation thanked police for clearing the air.

failed_wrong_accusation.title: BLUE RIBBON CASE STALLS
failed_wrong_accusation.summary: The inquiry into Elena Cross's disappearance has no new leads.
failed_wrong_accusation.body: Witnesses have stopped talking. Payments to the Halcyon Ridge Trust continue.

withdrawn.title: BLUE RIBBON INQUIRY GOES QUIET
withdrawn.summary: Few new questions are being asked about the gala.
withdrawn.body: Volunteers say the atmosphere at the Foundation has settled down.

withdrawn.title: SCHOLARSHIP DRIVE BREAKS FUNDRAISING RECORD
withdrawn.summary: Treasurer Augustus Pell thanked donors at a crowded reception.
withdrawn.body: Payments to the Halcyon Ridge Trust were not discussed.

withdrawn.title: ELENA CROSS CASE MARKED UNRESOLVED
withdrawn.summary: Police have scaled back the search for the missing organizer.
withdrawn.body: Her family continues to appeal for information.

success.title: BLUE RIBBON TRUSTEES PLEDGE FULL CO-OPERATION
success.summary: New trustees say every disbursement will be published.
success.body: Federal investigators continue to examine the Scholarship Drive's accounts.

failed.title: BLUE RIBBON CASE QUIET AFTER SETBACK
failed.body: Volunteers decline to talk about the benefit.

withdrawn.title: LIFE RETURNS TO NORMAL AT THE BLUE RIBBON FOUNDATION
withdrawn.summary: The Scholarship Drive's next benefit is already being planned.

news.deathHeadline: RESIDENT FOUND DEAD AT HOME. POLICE REPORT NO SIGN OF FORCED ENTRY.

invasion.caption: Headlights sweep across the ceiling. A gray sedan stops outside and its engine cuts out.
The bedroom door swings open. Someone wearing a blue ribbon pin steps inside.
You were told to stop asking.
